title: Order spike pipeline: allocate 100-point governor capacity budget
prompt: Order spike pipeline: allocate 100-point governor capacity budget
detail: During a peak volume spike (10,000 orders/sec into Salesforce), allocate your 100-point transaction envelope across four critical architectural resources to prevent transaction rollback under high concurrency.

categories.label: Database SOQL & locking budget
categories.description: Controls indexed SOQL selectivity and FOR UPDATE parent-child lock contention.

categories.label: Apex CPU execution budget
categories.description: Allocated to high-density bulkified triggers and JSON business validation.

categories.label: Platform cache & heap memory
categories.description: In-memory state and Platform Cache session partition sizing.

categories.label: Outbound event egress budget
categories.description: High-volume Platform Event publishing and asynchronous queue handoffs.

analysis: During 10,000 orders/sec spikes, prioritizing CPU budget (≥30 pts) ensures complex business validation completes without hitting 10,000ms CPU timeouts. Keeping SOQL budget (≤25 pts) forces the use of Platform Cache and Skinny Tables, eliminating unindexed database row lock contention.
